entities.name: Muldrotha
entities.description: A Dominarian elemental avatar, spawn of Multani and Maro-Sorcerer of Urborg.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: Muldrotha's father, the Maro-Sorcerer of Yavimaya.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: The land of Multani, whose offshoot is on Urborg.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: The land that gave Muldrotha life.

entities.name: Slimefoot
entities.description: A being who requested Muldrotha's help against Yargle.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The ship whose crew Muldrotha helped.

entities.name: Yargle
entities.description: A being Muldrotha helped defeat, later fighting Phyrexians.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Multani bound himself to Yargle.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders Yargle fought and ate.

events.summary: At Slimefoot's and Urborg's spirits' request, Muldrotha helped the Weatherlight crew defeat Yargle.
events.quote: she helped the Weatherlight crew to defeat Yargle

events.summary: Muldrotha persuaded Multani to help Yargle, and Multani bound himself to Yargle.

relations.note: Spawn of Multani; he is her father
relations.quote: She is the spawn of Multani
